focus_areas: Grounding integrity of feathered feet in snow (Depth/Geometry)
Anatomical plausibility of avian features via VLM reasoning
Boundary sharpness of white undertail coverts
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the black body plumage and the white undertail coverts. AI models often struggle with this high-contrast boundary, resulting in grey smudging or fused feathers. Also, verify that the red caruncle is a distinct anatomical feature and not just a red blob painted on the head. Crucially, analyze the feet: do they physically displace the snow, or do they melt into the background texture?
image_description: A male black grouse (blackcock) standing in a snowy, frost-covered environment. The bird displays glossy black plumage with a distinct red eyebrow comb (caruncle) above the eye. Its tail is fanned out, revealing prominent white undertail coverts and outer tail feathers curving outward in a lyre shape. The legs appear feathered down to the feet.
